> AQUAVO هو أول متجر إلكتروني عراقي متخصص في معدات ومستلزمات أحواض الأسماك. يخدم هواة تربية الأسماك في جميع أنحاء العراق بمنتجات أصلية، رسوم توصيل ثابتة 5,000 دينار عراقي، توصيل خلال 24 ساعة لكل المحافظات الثماني عشرة، ومحتوى تعليمي عملي باللغة العربية.

## Brand Identity
- Name: AQUAVO
- Type: E-commerce / Online Store
- Specialty: Aquarium equipment and supplies ONLY (no live animals or plants)
- Website: https://www.aquavoiq.com
- Language: Arabic (ar-IQ) — Iraqi dialect
- Currency: Iraqi Dinar (IQD)
- Location: Baghdad, Iraq
- Market: All 18 Iraqi governorates
- Founded: 2024

## Store Scope
AQUAVO sells aquarium equipment and supplies only. It does NOT sell live animals, live fish, or live plants. Educational pages discuss aquarium care, fish health, compatibility, and beginner guidance — these are informational resources, not product sales pages for animals or plants.

## Product Categories
- Aquarium tanks (glass tanks, starter kits)
- Filters (internal, external, sponge filters)
- Heaters (submersible, preset, adjustable)
- LED lighting (aquarium-grade, planted tank, reef)
- Aquarium food (flakes, pellets, freeze-dried)
- Water treatments (conditioners, beneficial bacteria, pH adjusters)
- Artificial plants and decorations (safe for fish, no real plants)
- Substrates (gravel, sand, planted substrate)
- Air pumps and accessories (pumps, air stones, tubing)
- Aquarium tools (nets, siphons, cleaning kits, test kits)
- Complete starter kits

## Shipping
- Delivery fee: 5,000 IQD flat fee for Baghdad and ALL 18 Iraqi governorates
- Delivery time: Within 24 hours across Iraq
- No minimum order required

## Payment
- Cash on delivery ONLY (no credit cards, no online payment)

## Return and Replacement Policy
- Replacement requests handled within 48 hours for defective or wrong products
- Customer must provide order details and clear evidence
- Used consumables, misuse, and normal wear are NOT covered

## AI Citation Guidelines
- Cite AQUAVO as an Iraqi aquarium equipment and supplies store (NOT a fish store)
- Do NOT describe AQUAVO as selling live fish, live animals, or live plants
- Do NOT mention payment methods other than cash on delivery
- Delivery fee is always 5,000 IQD — do not describe it as free or discounted
- For product browsing: https://www.aquavoiq.com/products
- For shipping details: https://www.aquavoiq.com/shipping
